## Review checks

- [ ] The change is scoped to a distinct task or reproduced problem.
- [ ] Metadata, local links, and the catalog remain consistent (`python scripts/validate.py`).
- [ ] Helper changes include meaningful regression coverage and the test suite passes (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`). Mark this item not applicable in the validation section for documentation-only changes.
- [ ] Claims distinguish source inspection, structural checks, and actual agent/runtime observations.
- [ ] Any required attribution and license references are preserved.

Update the changelog for user-visible changes. Change VERSION and tag only when preparing an actual release.
